description: Validates Kubernetes Service manifests for port validity, allowed service types, selector correctness, and namespace isolation

rules.description: k8s-service-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare name, selector, and a non-empty ports array
The Service selector must correspond to labels declared on a known workload artifact (k8s-workload-artifact.json) in the project. A selector with no matching workload routes traffic to zero pods
rules.note: Skipped when no k8s-workload-artifact.json is present in the project

rules.description: Every port entry must declare a valid port number (1–65535), a targetPort or port name, and if protocol is set it must be TCP, UDP, or SCTP
No two entries in the ports array may declare the same port number. Duplicates cause the Kubernetes API server to reject the manifest
Service type must be one of: ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName, Headless. LoadBalancer and NodePort carry security warnings — they expose ports outside the cluster

warnings.LoadBalancer: creates a public internet-facing LB by default — add annotations to restrict
warnings.NodePort: exposes a port on every cluster node — prefer Ingress for external traffic
warnings.ExternalName: routes to an external DNS target — verify the target is intentional

rules.description: k8s-service-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

namespace must be declared (default namespace is an antipattern in shared clusters). LoadBalancer Services must include cloud-specific annotations — without them the cloud controller creates a public internet-facing LB
